## Question 1: Plot force
Equations used:
$$
F=\frac{2\left(kqQ\right)\left(x-x_{0}\right)}{r^{3}} \quad
r=\sqrt{\left(x-x_{0}\right)^{2}+\left(\frac{a}{2}\right)^{2}}
$$
```{python}
x0 = 0.0279*np.sqrt(3)/2
y0 = 0.0279/2
x = np.linspace(0.01, 0.15, 500)

r_bc = np.sqrt((x-x0)**2 + y0**2)
F_origin = -(8.98755e9*3.24e-9*6.15e-9) / (x**2) #radius is just x val
F_top_bottom = 2*(8.98755e9*3.24e-9*6.15e-9) * (x-x0)/(r_bc**3)
F_net = F_origin + F_top_bottom

df = pd.DataFrame({'x_m': x, 'Force_N': F_net})
ggplot(df, aes(x='x_m', y='Force_N')) + \
    geom_line(color='blue', size=1) + \
    geom_hline(yintercept=0, linetype='dashed', color='red') + \
    coord_cartesian(xlim=[0.01, 0.15], ylim=[-0.001, 0.001]) + \
    labs(
        title='Net Force on Charge Q vs Position',
        x='Position x (m)',
        y='Net Horizontal Force (N)'
    ) + \
    ggsize(700, 400)
```

## Question 2: Find electric field
Equation used:
$E=8.99\cdot10^{9}\sum_{n=1}^{50}\frac{q\vec{r}}{r^{3}}$
```{python}
data = pd.read_excel('hw_01_pr2_data.xlsx', header=None)
q = data.iloc[0].values
i_hat = data.iloc[1].values
j_hat = data.iloc[2].values
i_field = 0
j_field = 0

for i in range(50):
    r = np.sqrt((2.74-i_hat[i])**2 + (-6.12-j_hat[i])**2)
    i_field += q[i]*(2.74-i_hat[i]) / r**3
    j_field += q[i]*(-6.12-j_hat[i]) / r**3

i_field *= 8.99e9
j_field *= 8.99e9
net_field = np.sqrt(i_field**2 + j_field**2) 

print(f"The net field on the point is \x1B[3mE = {i_field:.2e} i\u0302 N/C + {j_field:.2e} j\u0302 N/C = {net_field:.2e} Newtons per Coulomb\x1B[0m")
```

## Question 2: Timing of contact
Equation used:
$a=\frac{8.99\cdot10^{9}\cdot\frac{\left(7.48\cdot10^{-10}\right)^{2}}{r^{2}}}{4.35\cdot10^{-3}}$

```{python}
time = velocity = 0
radius = 2.46e-1
while radius > (6.48e-2):
    accel = 8.99e9 * ((7.48e-10)**2)/(radius**2) / 4.35e-3
    velocity += accel*0.001
    radius -= velocity*0.002 #time * two particles
    time +=0.001
print(f"It took the particles {time:.3g} seconds to collide")
```
